blocking.title: The formation panel is not the formation the click selected: playing Germany at a front (seed 4441, day 60), 7 of 12 clicks on own divisions selected a German formation but the panel showed another (Polish 3, Italian 2, other German 2); game.tsx onPick opens the panel with formationPick (any nation) while PlayerControl.click selects with formationAt (played nation). Pre-existing code, first found this run.
blocking.fix: While playing, when a click selects a formation, open that formation's panel (or one picker with own formations first); bar: on c20_sx's case 12 of 12 panels are the selected formation's.
